comments: Checks native Android apps (Android Emulator or a phone over adb), not web content, and does not map results to WCAG. Free, MIT license. Source: https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android
features: Free open-source macOS app to check Android app accessibility on the emulator or a phone: audit TalkBack focus order, and toggle TalkBack, font scale, bold text, dark mode and RTL in one click to test how screens hold up. Layout Inspector shows sizes in dp.
title: Oh My Android
